name: 2023 Cost-effectiveness analysis of IRD's ZM and mCCT program in Sindh
summary: Sends small mobile cash incentives and uses an electronic vaccination registry to raise child vaccination in Sindh, Pakistan. GiveWell's spreadsheet "2023 Cost-effectiveness analysis of IRD's ZM and mCCT program in Sindh", linked from its grant page. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.
